verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a real error-search query syntax with field qualifiers and negation (e.g. `class:UserError -tag:wip component:"UsersController"`). Search works in a single project or across all projects, covers type, location and meta-data, and includes a query builder, while BadgerQL adds filtering and aggregation over Insights events. Deploy-relative filtering (`occurred.after:'last deploy'`) partly covers release scoping. missing for 10: explicit environment filter syntax, explicit release/version field filter beyond deploy-relative time, documented custom-property qualifiers, independent hands-on corroboration.
